items.exampleZh: 這間工廠有五十位員工。

items.exampleEn: I have a meeting at ten.
I read your message this morning.
items.exampleZh: 我今天早上看了你的訊息。
寫作是一項重要的技能。

items.exampleEn: I have a job interview tomorrow.
items.exampleZh: 我明天有一個工作面試。

items.exampleEn: I sleep eight hours every night.

items.sentenceEn: I have a meeting this afternoon.

items.audioEn: Sorry, I am in a meeting. I will call you back later.
items.audioZh: 抱歉，我在開會，我晚點回電給你。

items.sentenceEn: Your phone has a new message.
items.sentenceZh: 你的手機有一則新訊息。

items.sentenceEn: The workers have a meeting at nine.

items.stemEn: I can't talk now. Please leave a ____.
items.stemZh: 我現在不方便講話，請留言。

items.stemEn: He works hard, and his business is very ____.
items.stemZh: 他工作很努力，他的生意很成功。

items.passageEn: Ken has a job interview today. He gets up at six, but he did not sleep well. He looks at his phone. There is a message from his mother: "Good luck!" At the interview, he talks about his skills. The interview is successful, and he gets the job!
items.passageZh: Ken 今天有一場工作面試。他六點起床，但昨晚沒睡好。他看了看手機，有一則媽媽傳來的訊息：「祝你好運！」面試時，他談了自己的技能。面試很成功，他得到了這份工作！

rubricZh: 數量大於一，meeting 用複數 meetings
「有會議」可用 have（例如 I have three meetings）；寫 There are three meetings today. 也正確
「正在睡覺」用現在進行式（例如 is sleeping）；寫 is asleep 也正確
「寶寶」可寫，例如 the baby、my baby 等
